# Time Off

{{< alert color="info" >}}Fixture content for automated tests.{{< /alert >}}

## Vacation

Acme Robotics gives every employee 22 days of paid vacation per year. Vacation requests go through the Kestrel portal and need manager approval at least ten business days ahead.

<!-- internal note that should be stripped -->

## Sick leave

Employees may take up to 12 paid sick days per year. A doctor's note is required after three consecutive sick days.

## Public holidays

Public holidays follow the calendar of the country where the employee lives and do not count against vacation.
